measurement_note: Size is n, the number of distinct array values. Legal tiers 3, 6, and 12 span 4x. Every tier has total product target squared but no subset with product target, so the accepted divisibility-pruned include/exclude search must reject it. A correct slower baseline enumerates the same subsets but recomputes each product by scanning all n values and must fail only scaling.
